notes.subject: ananit bilong stik
notes.rationale: תחת השבט: rit bilong kaunim sipsip wantaim stik (Levitikus 27:32), o roding samting bilong kastim — ol man i no save long wanpela mining

notes.subject: ananit bilong stik
notes.rationale: pasin bilong kaunim ol sipsip wantaim stik, olsem ol man i kaunim olgeta manmeri

notes.subject: rop
notes.rationale: מסרת em i ban o rop; Strong i tok 'band', tasol konteks bilong kontrak i tok 'rop bilong holim'

translation: Na bai mi salim yupela ⟨את⟩ i go ananit bilong stik, na bai mi bringim yupela ⟨את⟩ i kam insait long rop bilong kontrak.
